profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Guanzhou, with ticker WRD and SEC CIK 0001867729. The company describes itself as a leading, commercial-stage global company that develops autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4. Its website says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

The company says it operates the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and mature autonomous driving solutions spanning L2 to L4. It is listed on Nasdaq under WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. The site notes recognition in Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for WeRide in the provided facts, and no additional product names beyond Robotaxi appear there.
